exposure: Epidural analgesia with 0.1% ropivacaine combined with 0.1 ug/mL dexmedetomidine (DEX)
Epidural analgesia with 0.1% ropivacaine combined with 0.2 ug/mL DEX
Epidural analgesia with 0.1% ropivacaine combined with 0.3 ug/mL DEX
Epidural analgesia with 0.1% ropivacaine combined with 0.3 ug/mL sufentanil (control group)
outcome: Number of times additional patient-controlled analgesia (PCA) was administered
cohort: The study included 400 parturient women who were randomly assigned to four groups for epidural analgesia during labor.
finding: Epidural analgesia with 0.1% ropivacaine combined with 0.2 ug/mL dexmedetomidine provides ideal analgesic effects, higher maternal satisfaction, and reduces the incidence of pruritus compared with the combination of 0.1% ropivacaine and 0.3 ug/mL sufentanil for labor pain relief.
